$comment: Marketplace catalog listings (third-party sellers on a retail site). Text-only domain — the submission is the listing title + description + structured attributes.

product_category.description: Primary category of the item being sold, judged from title and description.

price_usd.description: Listed price in USD; null if no price is present.

luxury_brand_mentioned.description: Luxury brand named in the listing (e.g. Rolex, Louis Vuitton, Gucci, Hermes, Cartier); null if none.

claims_authentic.description: True if the listing asserts authenticity ('100% authentic', 'genuine', 'with papers').

health_claim_present.description: True if the listing claims to treat, cure, prevent, or diagnose a medical condition.

fda_approval_claimed.description: True if the listing claims FDA approval, clearance, or endorsement.

contains_contact_info.description: True if a phone number, email address, or messaging handle (WhatsApp, Telegram) appears anywhere in the listing.

requests_offplatform_payment.description: True if the listing asks buyers to pay outside the marketplace (Venmo, Zelle, wire, 'message me to pay less').

age_restricted_item.description: True if the item is a knife, blade, airsoft/BB device, lighter fluid, or similar age-restricted product.
